meaning:
κατα-μανθάνω
[in LXX: Gen.34:1 (רָאָה), Job.35:4 (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al. ;]
to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): Mat.6:28.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
